Common.Loading: Reading compendiums… (takes a moment the first time only)

Plan.SheetHint: Sheet plan — continues from the sheet as it is and plans the levels to come. Can be applied when you level up.
Plan.FreeHint: Free plan — a what-if build from scratch (another class, another archetype …), for comparing.
Plan.DeleteBody: Delete the plan '{name}'? This cannot be undone.
Plan.FreeNote: A free plan, for comparing. To apply to the sheet, use a 'continue from the sheet' plan.

Top.PreviewHint: Preview attributes, skills and statistics at this level

List.PickHint: Click an entry on the left to see it here. Double-click or press 'Choose' to pick it.
List.LegendHint: Prerequisites are read from their text. ? means a condition the builder cannot judge (a deity, focus spells, 'A or B' …) — read it yourself. ? entries stay visible with 'prerequisites met'.
List.LegacyDisabled: Legacy content is hidden by the world setting.

Pick.HeritageHint: This ancestry's heritages first, then versatile heritages (any ancestry).
Pick.ArchetypeHint: Archetype feats: take the Dedication feat first, then that archetype's feats. Another dedication only after two more feats of that archetype.
Pick.DeityHint: Optional. Classes that need a deity (cleric, champion …) pick it here. Choose again to clear.

Locked.Sheet: Up to level {level} this plan follows the sheet; it plans from the next level on.
Locked.FreeHint: To try another ancestry, background or class, add a 'different build from scratch' plan with + above.
Locked.UnlockHint: Allow changing feats, boosts and skill increases of levels the sheet already has.
Locked.RelockHint: Lock again (your changes stay in the plan).
Locked.UnlockBody: Up to Lv {level} the sheet already has these levels. Unlocked, you can change their feats, boosts and skill increases; Apply then replaces the sheet's feat in that slot (the old one is removed). Ancestry, background and class stay locked.

Attr.Title: Attribute boosts
Attr.Hint: Pick the boosts of your ancestry, background, class and the 4 free boosts at level 1. Levels 5, 10, 15 and 20 give 4 more each. From level 5, a boost to a modifier of +4 or more is a partial boost (two make +1).
Attr.AltToggle: Alternate ancestry boosts: 2 free boosts instead of the fixed boosts and flaw

Skills.Title: Skills (level 1)
Skills.Hint: Skills from your class and background are trained automatically. You pick {n} more ({left} left), including your Intelligence modifier.
Skills.Auto: Trained by your class or background

Level.IncreaseHint: At this level a skill can go up to {rank} (master from level 7, legendary from 15).
Level.BoostHint: Four different attributes. At +4 or more a boost is partial (½); the second partial boost gives +1.
Level.Nothing: Nothing to choose at this level.
Level.RaiseApply: Raise to level {level} and apply the plan
Level.DetailHint: Click a feat or feature to read it here.

Overview.UploadHint: Upload a picture (large pictures are made smaller first)
Overview.TokenHint: Token picture (the portrait is used if none)
Overview.Ring: Use a token ring (portrait inside the ring)
Overview.AllSet: Everything up to level {level} is chosen.
Overview.CreateHint: Creates a level {level} character. The rest of the plan stays on the sheet to apply when you level up.
Overview.CreateNeed: Choose ancestry, heritage, background, class, key attribute, the 4 level-1 boosts and level-1 skills first.
Overview.ApplyCurrent: Apply what's missing up to level {level}
Overview.StatsNeed: Choose an ancestry and a class to see numbers.

Detail.ChoiceAsk: {n} more choice(s) are asked by PF2e when applying to the sheet.
Detail.ToChatHint: Post this to chat as a card, so the GM sees what you mean.

Stat.Note: Calculated by PF2e. Equipment, choices made when applying and items granted by feats may be missing.

Compare.Title: Compare — {name}
Compare.Note: Green: better than the first column, red: worse. Previews are close estimates (no equipment, no later choices).

Create.Confirm: Create {name} as a level {level} character? PF2e may ask a few questions afterwards.
Create.NoGM: A GM must be online to create a character (the GM's client makes it).
Create.Timeout: No answer from the GM. Try again in a moment.
Create.NoUpload: You may not upload files. Ask the GM for the 'Upload New Files' permission.

Apply.Title: Apply the plan up to level {level}
Apply.Body: This is added to the sheet (nothing already there is replaced):
Apply.Prompts: PF2e asks for any choice the plan left open.
Apply.Nothing: Nothing to apply — the sheet already follows the plan.

Card.Title: {name} — level {level}!
Card.Body: What the builder plan '{plan}' has for this level:

Welcome.Title: Character Builder
Welcome.Body: You don't have a character yet. Build one step by step? (You can always open it with 'Create Character' in the Actors tab.)

Translation.Title: Korean translation
Translation.Body: The character builder is tuned to Rutz's Korean translation (names, descriptions, prerequisites). It is recommended to use it.
Translation.Hint: Shown once. The builder also works with other translations.

Settings.PerPlayerHint: How many characters a player may create with the builder (0 = no limit). An assigned character counts. GMs are not limited.
Settings.Ownership: Other players' access to new characters
Settings.OwnershipHint: 'Follow the world' uses the default access most player characters of this world have. The creating player is always the owner.
Settings.AllowLevelUp: Players may raise their level in the builder
Settings.AllowLevelUpHint: When off, only the GM raises levels; players apply their plan to the level they reached.
Settings.LevelUpCardHint: When a character gains a level, its owner gets a whispered card with an 'apply the plan' button.
Settings.PromptNew: Offer the builder to players without a character
Settings.PromptNewHint: On login, players without a character are asked whether to open the builder.
Settings.FolderHint: Actor folder name (empty: no folder). Created if missing.
Settings.PacksHint: Comma-separated pack IDs (e.g. pf2e.feats-srd, my-homebrew.feats). Empty: chosen by name (feat · ancestr · heritage · background · class).
Settings.TrModuleHint: Empty: looks for a Korean translation module with 'rutz' in its id, title or authors.
Settings.TrUrlHint: Manifest or page URL shown in the note (optional).
Settings.HideLegacyHint: Hide legacy content for every user in this world and lock the per-window toggle. Off by default. Existing plans are preserved.
Settings.PacksMenuHint: Pick the packs ancestries, classes and feats are read from. Companion modules (Companion Compendia …), packs switched off in the compendium browser and system packs a translation replaces are left out by default.
Settings.TidyChoicesHint: In PF2e's own "choose one" windows (bard muse, cleric doctrine …) leave out packs switched off in the compendium browser and system packs a translation replaces, and list each option once. Answers given in the builder go in without a window either way.
Settings.LevelCantripsHint: For spellbook/familiar classes (wizard, witch …) a cantrip may be one of the two spells learned each level. The rules text ('ranks for which you have spell slots') is ambiguous — decide at your table.
Settings.AutoClassSpellsHint: When a feat or class feature is gained outside the builder (on the sheet), the spells it grants (e.g. a witch lesson's hex and familiar spell) go into the spellcasting entries.

Ask.Title: Choices
Ask.Body: {name} has choices. Answer now and PF2e won't ask again when applying.

Pending.Title: Not chosen yet
Pending.Asks: Choices PF2e will ask while applying: {n}
Pending.Hint: If you go on, empty slots stay empty (fill them on the sheet later).

Spells.Title: Spell plan
Spells.Hint: Choose how the character casts and the spells to learn each level (spellbook / repertoire). Creating the character or applying the plan makes the spellcasting entry and adds the spells the class and its subclass give (e.g. a bard's Counter Performance, Courageous Anthem and muse spell) — focus spells go to their own focus entry.
Spells.NoCastingHint: Pick a tradition if your class casts spells.
Spells.SubclassHint: This class's tradition depends on a subclass (bloodline, patron …) — pick it yourself.
Spells.AtLevel: Spells to learn at this level (up to rank {rank})
Spells.PickHint: Pick as many as you like — double-click or 'Choose'; again to remove. Faded rows are planned at another level.
Spells.ListHint: This class prepares from its whole tradition list, so there is nothing to learn. You can still note favourite spells here.
Spells.NoClassSpells: No spells from class features, subclass or planned feats yet (they appear once a patron, bloodline, muse … is chosen).
Spells.ClassGives: Spells the class gives up to level {level} (depends on planned feats)
Spells.Mode_book: Spellbook: a set number at 1st level, then 2 spells of any rank each level. Prepare as many as your slots each day.
Spells.Mode_rep: Repertoire: learn one spell of a rank for each slot of that rank.
Spells.Mode_list: Whole list: prepare from your tradition's entire list each day; nothing to learn.

Learn.WizardNote: Plus 2 curriculum 1st-rank spells, and 1 curriculum spell per new rank.
Learn.WitchNote: Plus the patron's spell your familiar learns.
Learn.NecroNote: Harm is added on its own.
Learn.ClericNote: Divine font gives extra heal/harm slots (4 at 1, 5 at 5, 6 at 15).
Learn.SorcNote: The first spell of each rank (and one cantrip) comes from your bloodline and is not counted here.

Extra.Psychic: Your conscious mind adds 3 psi cantrips.
Extra.Sorcerer: Bloodline spells sit within these slots.
Extra.Wizard: Plus one curriculum slot per rank.

Spells.ResyncHint: Put the spells granted by the sheet's class features and feats (patron, lessons, bloodline …) into the spellcasting and focus entries, and set the daily slots from the class table.

DeityAlignment.Hint: Legacy alignment: {alignment} (the deity, not its allowed followers)

Packs.Title: Compendiums the builder reads
Packs.Hint: Only ticked packs appear in the builder lists. Rows changed from the default are highlighted.
Packs.Saved: Compendium choice saved; open builders reload.

Choice.PickHint: Click one to read it on the right; double-click or press Choose to pick it.
Choice.AskPeek: Pick one to read its description here.

Setup.Title: Spell setup
Setup.Book: Write {c} cantrips and {s} spells in your spellbook → prepare {pc} cantrips and {ps} spells each day.
Setup.Rep: Learn {c} cantrips and {s} spells in your repertoire (cast freely, up to your slots).
Setup.List: Prepare {pc} cantrips and {ps} spells from your whole list each day.
Setup.NoTradition: tradition not set (comes from your subclass)
Setup.FeatHint: Focus spells come from class features, your subclass and planned feats; change the feats and this list changes. Creating the character sets up the entries, focus spells and slots.

Fam.Title: Familiar Builder
Fam.CannotCreate: You may not create actors. Ask the GM to make a familiar actor with this character as master.
Fam.CountHint: Familiar and master abilities per day — as PF2e works it out from class features and feats (Familiar, Enhanced Familiar, witch's familiar …).
Fam.NoFamiliar: No familiar actor has this character as master. Create one above.
Fam.PickHint: Click an ability to read it and its prerequisites here. Double-click to add.
Fam.Patron: Granted by a witch patron — it comes with the patron and isn't chosen.
Fam.Specific: Only for a specific familiar ({folder}) — the GM should confirm.

KindHint.master: Abilities you (the master) gain — they count with the familiar abilities.
KindHint.special: Abilities only certain familiars (object familiars, undead, shikigami …) or witch patrons have.

Need.Rank: Able to cast rank {n} spells with slots
Need.Cantrips: Prepares cantrips or has them in a repertoire

Ask.Shadow: Shadow familiar only (any familiar for a shadowcaster)
